findings.message: Use 'Object.hasOwn()' instead of 'Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call()'. The long form exists because an object can define its own `hasOwnProperty`, or have a null prototype and none at all, so calling it through `Object.prototype` was the only safe spelling. `Object.hasOwn` is that spelling with a name, and it cannot be shadowed by the object being asked about.
